Explicit experimental VDN extension, not paper-softmax or trained quality equivalence. Independent stage config, no extra diffusion NFE or dense fallback. Workspace is adapter working-set estimate, not total VRAM. Unsupported kernels fail normally.

MiniMaxH3VDNRelayAuditEXPT8.name: MiniMaxH3VDNRelayAuditEXPT8
MiniMaxH3VDNRelayAuditEXPT8.display_name: H3 VDN · External Prompt Relay Audit (T8 EXP)
MiniMaxH3VDNRelayAuditEXPT8.description: Wire after this stage's sampler/save. Reports real window/linear calls and coverage, not just the presence of a Relay plan. Unknown bypassed producers remain unverified.

MiniMaxH3ProgressiveStagePlanEXPT8.name: MiniMaxH3ProgressiveStagePlanEXPT8
MiniMaxH3ProgressiveStagePlanEXPT8.display_name: H3 Progressive · Plan + LOW Source (T8 EXP)
MiniMaxH3ProgressiveStagePlanEXPT8.description: Plan only: no MODEL, conditioning, sampling or learned lift. Original native Euler AV time grid. Empty T2VA/I2VA or explicit initialized AV. Not an accepted-parent continuation or standalone Avatar delivery contract.

MiniMaxH3ProgressiveStageConditioningEXP.name: MiniMaxH3ProgressiveStageConditioningEXPT8
MiniMaxH3ProgressiveStageConditioningEXP.display_name: H3 Progressive · ONE Stage Conditioning (T8 EXP)
MiniMaxH3ProgressiveStageConditioningEXP.description: Prepare one selected stage's native conditioning. Use separate nodes/inputs for independently editable LOW and HIGH prompts. Only LOW reference latent is resized; HIGH retains its original guide. No model call. Relay requires its own paired stage-layout adapter, not an unpaired copied binding.

MiniMaxH3ProgressiveLowStageEXPT8.name: MiniMaxH3ProgressiveLowStageEXPT8
MiniMaxH3ProgressiveLowStageEXPT8.display_name: H3 Progressive · LOW Sampler Only (T8 EXP)
MiniMaxH3ProgressiveLowStageEXPT8.description: Execute only LOW native Euler. No HIGH model/prompt/lifter input. Returns typed model-space clean_video + evolving audio_next + original audio noise, not completed AV or ordinary denoised output. Connect the dedicated Lift Input and Save nodes.

MiniMaxH3ProgressiveLiftInputEXPT8.name: MiniMaxH3ProgressiveLiftInputEXPT8
MiniMaxH3ProgressiveLiftInputEXPT8.display_name: H3 Progressive · Boundary to External Lift Input (T8 EXP)
MiniMaxH3ProgressiveLiftInputEXPT8.description: No sampling or learned network executes. Converts only clean video to original VAE coordinates; zero audio is a lifter placeholder. The original evolving audio stays in low_boundary for HIGH. Connect the existing learned 3D latent upscaler using these target dimensions.

MiniMaxH3ProgressiveHighHandoffEXPT8.name: MiniMaxH3ProgressiveHighHandoffEXPT8
MiniMaxH3ProgressiveHighHandoffEXPT8.display_name: H3 Progressive · HIGH Handoff Only (T8 EXP)
MiniMaxH3ProgressiveHighHandoffEXPT8.description: Connect actual external learned output, frozen LOW boundary and independent HIGH clean source. Draws only HIGH video noise, restores original native AV coordinates and clean-source masks; no LOW/HIGH sampling or learned lift. For the original noise policy use video_noise seed=(LOW seed+1) modulo 2^64. Optional HIGH sigma tail must start at the frozen boundary. Full pretrained/effect/continuation qualification remains separate.

MiniMaxH3ProgressiveHighStageEXPT8.name: MiniMaxH3ProgressiveHighStageEXPT8
MiniMaxH3ProgressiveHighStageEXPT8.display_name: H3 Progressive · HIGH Sampler Only (T8 EXP)
MiniMaxH3ProgressiveHighStageEXPT8.description: Execute only the native Euler tail using explicit zero-noise reconstruction and the original clean source/masks. Independent MODEL/LoRA/conditions. seed is the sampler seed (original policy: same as LOW), not the HIGH video-noise seed. Never executes LOW or learned upscale; no automatic cache or retry.

MiniMaxH3ProgressiveLowSaveEXPT8.name: MiniMaxH3ProgressiveLowSaveEXPT8
MiniMaxH3ProgressiveLowSaveEXPT8.display_name: H3 Progressive · Save Frozen LOW Boundary (T8 EXP)
MiniMaxH3ProgressiveLowSaveEXPT8.description: Writes a new typed artifact with exact SHA under output/MiniMaxH3/progressive_stage_artifacts. No overwrite. Not ordinary Stage Save: evolving audio and clean video remain distinct. Unknown executable identity may be archived but not certified for persistent reuse. Save both path and SHA.

MiniMaxH3ProgressiveLowLoadEXPT8.name: MiniMaxH3ProgressiveLowLoadEXPT8
MiniMaxH3ProgressiveLowLoadEXPT8.display_name: H3 Progressive · Load Exact Frozen LOW Boundary (T8 EXP)
MiniMaxH3ProgressiveLowLoadEXPT8.description: Select completed LOW path and exact SHA. No MODEL loading or LOW sampling, and no assertion that today's LOW settings match this frozen artifact. Feed its boundary to Lift Input/HIGH Handoff; remove LOW output nodes from a HIGH-only recovery graph. Corruption/missing/busy artifacts fail, never silently regenerate.

MiniMaxH3ProgressiveHighSaveEXPT8.name: MiniMaxH3ProgressiveHighSaveEXPT8
MiniMaxH3ProgressiveHighSaveEXPT8.display_name: H3 Progressive · Save Completed HIGH AV (T8 EXP)
MiniMaxH3ProgressiveHighSaveEXPT8.description: Save typed completed HIGH with its execution receipt, exact output identity and metadata. Unique new artifact; never overwrites an old result. No additional sampling or learned lift. Save both path and SHA.

MiniMaxH3ProgressiveHighLoadEXPT8.name: MiniMaxH3ProgressiveHighLoadEXPT8
MiniMaxH3ProgressiveHighLoadEXPT8.display_name: H3 Progressive · Load Exact Completed HIGH AV (T8 EXP)
MiniMaxH3ProgressiveHighLoadEXPT8.description: Select frozen completed HIGH using path and SHA. Loads no models, runs no sampling/lift. Reconnect the returned AV to decoding or later stages. No implicit cache lookup, retry or claim of matching today's settings.

MiniMaxH3ProgressiveRelayStageApplyEXPT8.name: MiniMaxH3ProgressiveRelayStageApplyEXPT8
MiniMaxH3ProgressiveRelayStageApplyEXPT8.display_name: H3 Progressive · External Relay + ONE Stage Conditioning (T8 EXP)
MiniMaxH3ProgressiveRelayStageApplyEXPT8.description: Connect this phase's own paired Relay Conditioning MODEL/positive and original target-resolution guides. Rebinds actual LOW/HIGH packed layout and prepares stage guides, without sampling. Use instead of ONE Stage Conditioning, not after it. HIGH can use a different Relay Plan or be the only enabled phase. disabled removes only that authenticated Relay owner. Persistent effect identity is not yet certified.

MiniMaxH3ProgressiveLowEAVApplyEXPT8.name: MiniMaxH3ProgressiveLowEAVApplyEXPT8
MiniMaxH3ProgressiveLowEAVApplyEXPT8.display_name: H3 Progressive · External LOW EAV Apply (T8 EXP)
MiniMaxH3ProgressiveLowEAVApplyEXPT8.description: External Stage EAV Config -> this node -> LOW Sampler Only. Binds LOW's native mask and full absolute video clock, not local step progress. Optional Relay must be stage-bound first. No sampling here. CFG1; no learned/GPU/media quality or persistent effect identity qualification.

MiniMaxH3ProgressiveHighEAVApplyEXPT8.name: MiniMaxH3ProgressiveHighEAVApplyEXPT8
MiniMaxH3ProgressiveHighEAVApplyEXPT8.display_name: H3 Progressive · External HIGH EAV Apply (T8 EXP)
MiniMaxH3ProgressiveHighEAVApplyEXPT8.description: External Stage EAV Config -> this node -> HIGH Sampler Only. Uses the exact HIGH restart plan and clean-source mask, not its noisy state as an anchor. LOW effects may be absent or different. Optional Relay must be stage-bound first. CFG1; persistent effect identity remains unqualified.

MiniMaxH3ProgressiveLowEffectsAuditEXPT8.name: MiniMaxH3ProgressiveLowEffectsAuditEXPT8
MiniMaxH3ProgressiveLowEffectsAuditEXPT8.display_name: H3 Progressive · LOW Effects Execution Audit (T8 EXP)
MiniMaxH3ProgressiveLowEffectsAuditEXPT8.description: Reads actual immutable LOW completion evidence. No sampling or mutable Apply-node counter lookup. Missing effects and incomplete user-stack coverage never count as verified application.

MiniMaxH3ProgressiveHighEffectsAuditEXPT.name: MiniMaxH3ProgressiveHighEffectsAuditEXPT8
MiniMaxH3ProgressiveHighEffectsAuditEXPT.display_name: H3 Progressive · HIGH Effects Execution Audit (T8 EXP)
MiniMaxH3ProgressiveHighEffectsAuditEXPT.description: Reads actual immutable completed HIGH evidence; does not run LOW or inspect an old cached Apply counter.

MiniMaxH3AvatarSourceBindEXPT8.name: MiniMaxH3AvatarSourceBindEXPT8
MiniMaxH3AvatarSourceBindEXPT8.display_name: H3 Avatar · Bind Encoded Source + Recording (T8 EXP)
MiniMaxH3AvatarSourceBindEXPT8.description: Bind your selected encoded AV and original PCM. Requires explicit nested AV masks with audio=0, e.g. Audio Latent Control lock. No encoding/sampling; this records your selected pair, not VAE provenance. Keep this neutral source independent of HIGH prompts.

MiniMaxH3AvatarLowStageEXPT8.name: MiniMaxH3AvatarLowStageEXPT8
MiniMaxH3AvatarLowStageEXPT8.display_name: H3 Avatar · LOW Only — Recording Bound (T8 EXP)
MiniMaxH3AvatarLowStageEXPT8.description: Execute only initialized Avatar LOW. Use common Progressive Plan in initialized_av_exp mode and independent LOW EAV/Relay adapters. The completed boundary binds original recording/encoded source; no hidden HIGH or lift.

MiniMaxH3AvatarHighHandoffEXPT8.name: MiniMaxH3AvatarHighHandoffEXPT8
MiniMaxH3AvatarHighHandoffEXPT8.display_name: H3 Avatar · HIGH Handoff — Recording Anchor (T8 EXP)
MiniMaxH3AvatarHighHandoffEXPT8.description: Restore frozen Avatar LOW and external learned lift. Default HIGH source is the bound recording source. Optional HIGH video source/mask may change, but clean audio and zero audio mask must match. Feed common Progressive HIGH/EAV/Relay nodes. No sampling.

MiniMaxH3AvatarDeliveryAuditEXPT8.name: MiniMaxH3AvatarDeliveryAuditEXPT8
MiniMaxH3AvatarDeliveryAuditEXPT8.display_name: H3 Avatar · Deliver Original Recording + Audit (T8 EXP)
MiniMaxH3AvatarDeliveryAuditEXPT8.description: Verify the completed HIGH's recording binding. Return original selected PCM unchanged for explicit final mux, not generated/decoded audio. Accepts saved HIGH without source re-encoding or sampling. Reports latent anchor difference; does not certify trained lip sync, voice identity or quality.

MiniMaxH3ContinuationSourceEXPT8.name: MiniMaxH3ContinuationSourceEXPT8
MiniMaxH3ContinuationSourceEXPT8.display_name: H3 Continuation · Select Accepted Parent (T8 EXP)
MiniMaxH3ContinuationSourceEXPT8.description: Select the existing immediate accepted parent in an output chain. Validates revision, candidate, actual MP4/context bytes and previous job SHA. No VAE, sampling or chain creation. previous_job_sha256 authenticates the selected previous job only; it is NOT proof that today's edited stage models/prompts are the same job. Does not auto-accept or compose.

MiniMaxH3ContinuationContextsEXPT8.name: MiniMaxH3ContinuationContextsEXPT8
MiniMaxH3ContinuationContextsEXPT8.display_name: H3 Continuation · Prepare Accepted Contexts (T8 EXP)
MiniMaxH3ContinuationContextsEXPT8.description: Decode accepted MP4 last39 RGB frames, existing resize then current VAE for LOW motion guides only. HIGH completed AV and shared audio are unchanged. Neutral preparation: no HIGH prompt, model, sampling, accept or timeline update.

MiniMaxH3ContinuationPlanEXPT8.name: MiniMaxH3ContinuationPlanEXPT8
MiniMaxH3ContinuationPlanEXPT8.display_name: H3 Continuation · Geometry + Stage Plan (T8 EXP)
MiniMaxH3ContinuationPlanEXPT8.description: One native initialized Euler schedule and accepted-parent geometry. No HIGH prompt or condition dependency. Independent stages keep original AV clocks; not FastH3/HyperFlow/VDN math. Connect common Progressive Lift Input and external learned3D upscale.

clip.tooltip: Native MiniMax H3 Qwen3-VL CLIP.

audio_vae.tooltip: MiniMax H3 audio VAE.

context_audio.tooltip: video_and_audio continues the generated AV latent. video_only keeps motion context but leaves audio to the selected native/source mode.

first_frame.tooltip: Exact frame 0 for the first segment. Later segments normally ignore it; persistent_identity_reference may reuse it as a compatibility fallback.

first_frame_reuse.tooltip: segment0_only preserves legacy behavior. persistent_identity_reference adds one non-timeline image reference on continuation segments. A connected persistent_identity_image is preferred; otherwise first_frame is reused. This remains experimental, adds reference rows/VRAM, and is not identity lock.

persistent_identity_image.tooltip: Optional continuation-only identity crop. Prefer one clear face or upper-body image. It is ignored on segment 0 and unless first_frame_reuse is set to persistent_identity_reference; first_frame still owns exact frame 0.

persistent_identity_strategy.tooltip: single_reference uses persistent_identity_image when connected, otherwise first_frame. scene_plus_identity supplies both images as separate references; it costs more reference rows/VRAM and remains a gated experiment.

persistent_identity_interval.tooltip: Continuation injection interval. 1 preserves the existing every-segment behavior; 2 injects on continuation segments 1, 3, 5, ... and lets the intermediate segments use motion context only. This is an Experimental identity-versus-motion control, not an adaptive drift detector.

MiniMaxH3ContinuationConditioningEXPT8.name: MiniMaxH3ContinuationConditioningEXPT8
MiniMaxH3ContinuationConditioningEXPT8.display_name: H3 Continuation · ONE Phase Conditions (T8 EXP)
MiniMaxH3ContinuationConditioningEXPT8.description: Use independent LOW and HIGH nodes/prompts/references. Reuse the original native motion builder without resizing LOW guides twice. Only HIGH locks the completed video prefix. Both phases must retain matching source audio. Accepts external Bridge; for Relay connect projected compiled_prompt, then Continuation Relay Apply.

MiniMaxH3ContinuationLowStageEXPT8.name: MiniMaxH3ContinuationLowStageEXPT8
MiniMaxH3ContinuationLowStageEXPT8.display_name: H3 Continuation · LOW Sampler Only (T8 EXP)
MiniMaxH3ContinuationLowStageEXPT8.description: Only this prepared LOW stage. Original accepted-picture motion guides and native CFG1. Independent MODEL/LoRA/NOISE/conditions; no hidden HIGH/learned lift.

MiniMaxH3ContinuationHighHandoffEXPT8.name: MiniMaxH3ContinuationHighHandoffEXPT8
MiniMaxH3ContinuationHighHandoffEXPT8.display_name: H3 Continuation · HIGH Handoff Only (T8 EXP)
MiniMaxH3ContinuationHighHandoffEXPT8.description: Bind frozen LOW, external learned3D output and this prepared HIGH. Preserves original video renoise and evolving audio; HIGH's clean prefix is not the noisy restart. No sampling. Original video noise policy: LOW seed+1 modulo uint64. Optional HIGH tail starts at frozen sigma.

MiniMaxH3ContinuationHighStageEXPT8.name: MiniMaxH3ContinuationHighStageEXPT8
MiniMaxH3ContinuationHighStageEXPT8.display_name: H3 Continuation · HIGH Sampler Only (T8 EXP)
MiniMaxH3ContinuationHighStageEXPT8.description: Only the selected continuation HIGH. Independent MODEL/LoRA, conditions and external phase effects. Native CFG1, original AV/motion clocks. No LOW, lift, loop or auto-accept.

MiniMaxH3ContinuationRelayProjectEXPT8.name: MiniMaxH3ContinuationRelayProjectEXPT8
MiniMaxH3ContinuationRelayProjectEXPT8.display_name: H3 Continuation · External Relay Window (T8 EXP)
MiniMaxH3ContinuationRelayProjectEXPT8.description: Project one external global Relay plan to this accepted window using original absolute motion time. LOW/HIGH may use separate plan nodes. Connect compiled_prompt to the corresponding ONE Phase Conditions before Relay Apply. No encoding/sampling.

MiniMaxH3ContinuationRelayApplyEXPT8.name: MiniMaxH3ContinuationRelayApplyEXPT8
MiniMaxH3ContinuationRelayApplyEXPT8.display_name: H3 Continuation · External Relay ONE Phase (T8 EXP)
MiniMaxH3ContinuationRelayApplyEXPT8.description: Bind only this phase's prepared motion layout and projected events to its actual MODEL and CONDITIONING. Keep LOW and HIGH independent; no opposite-phase dependency. Apply before continuation EAV. Actual effect calls are recorded by common Progressive Effects Audit nodes.

MiniMaxH3ContinuationLowEAVApplyEXPT8.name: MiniMaxH3ContinuationLowEAVApplyEXPT8
MiniMaxH3ContinuationLowEAVApplyEXPT8.display_name: H3 Continuation · External LOW EAV (T8 EXP)
MiniMaxH3ContinuationLowEAVApplyEXPT8.description: Stage EAV Config applied only to this accepted-parent LOW. Retains native motion guides/masks and global 1-sigma clock. disabled preserves the input MODEL object.

MiniMaxH3ContinuationHighEAVApplyEXPT8.name: MiniMaxH3ContinuationHighEAVApplyEXPT8
MiniMaxH3ContinuationHighEAVApplyEXPT8.display_name: H3 Continuation · External HIGH EAV (T8 EXP)
MiniMaxH3ContinuationHighEAVApplyEXPT8.description: Stage EAV Config applied only to this HIGH's typed restart and original clean-source mask. No LOW dependency. Keeps the accepted completed-prefix motion contract.

MiniMaxH3ContinuationDeliveryEXPT8.name: MiniMaxH3ContinuationDeliveryEXPT8
MiniMaxH3ContinuationDeliveryEXPT8.display_name: H3 Continuation · Deliver Completed Window (T8 EXP)
MiniMaxH3ContinuationDeliveryEXPT8.description: Revalidate the selected accepted parent and return completed HIGH unchanged. Saved HIGH can load without VAE preparation/LOW/HIGH sampling. mux_audio None means use native decoded generated audio; an explicitly selected PCM is preserved. Does not write candidate, accept, append or compose; no equivalence claim for today's edited recipe and previous job.

MiniMaxH3HyperFlowHeadStageEXPT8.name: MiniMaxH3HyperFlowHeadStageEXPT8
MiniMaxH3HyperFlowHeadStageEXPT8.display_name: H3 HyperFlow · Continuous HEAD Only (T8 EXP)
MiniMaxH3HyperFlowHeadStageEXPT8.description: Only absolute0:split, capturing the exact raw model-space AV x_sigma. Independent MODEL/content LoRAs/conditions/NOISE. No TAIL or upscale. Requires dedicated HyperFlow Loader. No denoise masks in this continuous contract. Boundary is not clean x0 or a Progressive boundary. Current identity is process-local; disk resume and stage EAV/Relay adapters remain pending.

MiniMaxH3HyperFlowTailStageEXPT8.name: MiniMaxH3HyperFlowTailStageEXPT8
MiniMaxH3HyperFlowTailStageEXPT8.display_name: H3 HyperFlow · Continuous TAIL Only (T8 EXP)
MiniMaxH3HyperFlowTailStageEXPT8.description: Only absolute split:8 on the captured x_sigma, with independent MODEL/content LoRAs and conditions. Clone the same full H3 base and use the same original HyperFlow adapter. No fresh noise, resize or HEAD rerun. Seed is a model execution seed, not a new noise seed. This is NOT fresh-noise8+4/partial4+4/P7; no persisted-effect/GPU/media quality claim.

MiniMaxH3HyperFlowHeadSaveEXPT8.name: MiniMaxH3HyperFlowHeadSaveEXPT8
MiniMaxH3HyperFlowHeadSaveEXPT8.display_name: H3 HyperFlow · Save Frozen HEAD (T8 EXP)
MiniMaxH3HyperFlowHeadSaveEXPT8.description: Save exact raw x_sigma and separate Core scaffold; NOT completed clean x0. New unique artifact under output/MiniMaxH3/hyperflow_stage_artifacts. Save both path and SHA. Unknown user owners may be archived but cannot acquire certified cross-process reuse.

MiniMaxH3HyperFlowHeadLoadEXPT8.name: MiniMaxH3HyperFlowHeadLoadEXPT8
MiniMaxH3HyperFlowHeadLoadEXPT8.display_name: H3 HyperFlow · Load Exact Frozen HEAD (T8 EXP)
MiniMaxH3HyperFlowHeadLoadEXPT8.description: Load the selected path and SHA without MODEL loading or HEAD execution. Connect directly to continuous TAIL; same original base/HyperFlow adapter contents are checked there. TAIL conditions and content LoRAs remain independent. Remove HEAD output branches in a TAIL-only graph. Missing/corrupt/busy artifacts fail; no hidden regeneration. Not fresh-noise8+4/partial4+4/P7.

MiniMaxH3HyperFlowTailSaveEXPT8.name: MiniMaxH3HyperFlowTailSaveEXPT8
MiniMaxH3HyperFlowTailSaveEXPT8.display_name: H3 HyperFlow · Save Completed TAIL AV (T8 EXP)
MiniMaxH3HyperFlowTailSaveEXPT8.description: Save completed AV and its actual continuous TAIL receipt, no extra sampling. Unique new file; no overwrite, automatic cache lookup or quality claim. Save both path and SHA.

MiniMaxH3HyperFlowTailLoadEXPT8.name: MiniMaxH3HyperFlowTailLoadEXPT8
MiniMaxH3HyperFlowTailLoadEXPT8.display_name: H3 HyperFlow · Load Exact Completed TAIL AV (T8 EXP)
MiniMaxH3HyperFlowTailLoadEXPT8.description: Load frozen completed AV for decoding/delivery without diffusion MODEL, CLIP, HEAD or TAIL. Requires exact path/SHA. Does not claim today's changed settings match this selected artifact.

MiniMaxH3HyperFlowHeadEffectsBindEXPT8.name: MiniMaxH3HyperFlowHeadEffectsBindEXPT8
MiniMaxH3HyperFlowHeadEffectsBindEXPT8.display_name: H3 HyperFlow · Bind External HEAD Effects (T8 EXP)
MiniMaxH3HyperFlowHeadEffectsBindEXPT8.description: Dedicated HyperFlow Loader -> optional paired Prompt Relay Conditioning -> this binding -> optional external Stage EAV Apply -> HEAD Only sampler. No sampling here. Use the same split on this binding and HEAD. SIGMAS are for effect validation, not another sampler or Progressive plan. CFG1 for active effects. Keep the paired MODEL and CONDITIONING together. No GPU/quality claim.

MiniMaxH3HyperFlowTailEffectsBindEXPT8.name: MiniMaxH3HyperFlowTailEffectsBindEXPT8
MiniMaxH3HyperFlowTailEffectsBindEXPT8.display_name: H3 HyperFlow · Bind External TAIL Effects (T8 EXP)
MiniMaxH3HyperFlowTailEffectsBindEXPT8.description: Bind an independent TAIL MODEL/LoRAs and paired Relay conditions to the actual HEAD boundary. Optional external Stage EAV Apply uses returned sigmas/template/context. Template is NOT the raw x_sigma: keep continuous_boundary connected to TAIL Only. No new noise, upscale or HEAD execution. Supports loaded HEAD with certified identity. CFG1 for active effects; no GPU/quality claim.

MiniMaxH3HyperFlowHeadEffectsAuditEXPT8.name: MiniMaxH3HyperFlowHeadEffectsAuditEXPT8
MiniMaxH3HyperFlowHeadEffectsAuditEXPT8.display_name: H3 HyperFlow · HEAD Effects Execution Audit (T8 EXP)
MiniMaxH3HyperFlowHeadEffectsAuditEXPT8.description: Read immutable sampled HEAD effect coverage, not mutable Apply-node counters. Passes the exact typed boundary through. Missing/bypassed effects are not verified application.

MiniMaxH3HyperFlowTailEffectsAuditEXPT8.name: MiniMaxH3HyperFlowTailEffectsAuditEXPT8
MiniMaxH3HyperFlowTailEffectsAuditEXPT8.display_name: H3 HyperFlow · TAIL Effects Execution Audit (T8 EXP)
MiniMaxH3HyperFlowTailEffectsAuditEXPT8.description: Read immutable completed TAIL effect coverage; no HEAD rerun or old cached Apply counter lookup. Returns the typed completed result and its final AV for storage and decode. Not quality acceptance.

MiniMaxH3HyperFlowFreshStageSetupEXPT8.name: MiniMaxH3HyperFlowFreshStageSetupEXPT8
MiniMaxH3HyperFlowFreshStageSetupEXPT8.display_name: H3 HyperFlow · Separate Full8 / Partial4 / Fresh4 Setup (T8 EXP)
MiniMaxH3HyperFlowFreshStageSetupEXPT8.description: Dedicated HyperFlow Loader -> optional paired Prompt Relay Conditioning -> this setup -> optional external Stage EAV -> standard Core sampler or ONE Stage Sampler + Result. No sampling here. Full8 LOW uses completed output for learned3D; partial4 LOW uses denoised_output. HIGH uses fresh external NOISE and original audio rebase, not continuous raw x_sigma. Models, content LoRAs, prompts, noise and effects are independent. Active effects require CFG1.

MiniMaxH3HyperFlowFreshLiftInputEXPT8.name: MiniMaxH3HyperFlowFreshLiftInputEXPT8
MiniMaxH3HyperFlowFreshLiftInputEXPT8.display_name: H3 HyperFlow · Select LOW Learned-Lift Input (T8 EXP)
MiniMaxH3HyperFlowFreshLiftInputEXPT8.description: Read a verified LOW Stage Result (including explicitly loaded frozen LOW). Selects output for complete8 and denoised_output for partial4. Zero diffusion, noise or upscale calls. Connect the selected AV to the existing learned3D and external reconcile nodes; never to continuous TAIL.

MiniMaxH3HyperFlowFreshStageAuditEXPT8.name: MiniMaxH3HyperFlowFreshStageAuditEXPT8
MiniMaxH3HyperFlowFreshStageAuditEXPT8.display_name: H3 HyperFlow · Fresh Stage Execution Audit (T8 EXP)
MiniMaxH3HyperFlowFreshStageAuditEXPT8.description: Pass the exact Stage Result and both original Core outputs through. Reads immutable actual absolute step/EAV/Relay coverage, not stale Apply counters. Does not sample or certify quality.

MiniMaxH3HyperFlowFreshStageLoadEXPT8.name: MiniMaxH3HyperFlowFreshStageLoadEXPT8
MiniMaxH3HyperFlowFreshStageLoadEXPT8.display_name: H3 HyperFlow · Load Exact Frozen Fresh Stage (T8 EXP)
MiniMaxH3HyperFlowFreshStageLoadEXPT8.description: Read an exact Stage Save artifact by mandatory path and SHA; no sampling or model loading. LOW -> Lift Input -> original learned3D/reconcile -> independent HIGH with fresh NOISE. Completed HIGH can be decoded directly without any sampler. Does not match current LOW settings automatically. Existing generic Load schema and old workflows remain unchanged.

MiniMaxH3HyperFlowFreshLoaderEXPT8.name: MiniMaxH3HyperFlowFreshLoaderEXPT8
MiniMaxH3HyperFlowFreshLoaderEXPT8.display_name: H3 HyperFlow · Fresh Route Loader / Original Endpoint (T8 EXP)
MiniMaxH3HyperFlowFreshLoaderEXPT8.description: Load the original HyperFlow adapter for independently scheduled fresh stages. Uses original base time tensors recovered read-only from Core backups even when a sibling is resident. Same two-time formulas, no shared-model unload or LoRA removal. Legacy Loader stays unchanged. Use a full native H3 base; content LoRAs may be independent on each branch.

MiniMaxH3HyperFlowP7AcceptedParentEXPT8.name: MiniMaxH3HyperFlowP7AcceptedParentEXPT8
MiniMaxH3HyperFlowP7AcceptedParentEXPT8.display_name: H3 HyperFlow P7 · Select Existing Accepted Parent (T8 EXP)
MiniMaxH3HyperFlowP7AcceptedParentEXPT8.description: Read an existing P7 accepted immediate predecessor. Verify revision, candidate, actual MP4, LOW/HIGH contexts, completed audio and previous execution contract. The previous job SHA authenticates that parent, not today's edited models or prompts. No sampling, chain creation, acceptance or implicit reuse of the old P7 stage cache.

MiniMaxH3HyperFlowP7PrepareContextsEXPT8.name: MiniMaxH3HyperFlowP7PrepareContextsEXPT8
MiniMaxH3HyperFlowP7PrepareContextsEXPT8.display_name: H3 HyperFlow P7 · Prepare LOW/HIGH Continuation Contexts (T8 EXP)
MiniMaxH3HyperFlowP7PrepareContextsEXPT8.description: Use the accepted parent's last 39 decoded RGB24 frames, original resize and current VAE for LOW picture motion guides only. HIGH context and completed audio stay unchanged. A new explicit stage graph must consume these typed contexts; this node does not sample.

MiniMaxH3HyperFlowP7ConditioningEXPT8.name: MiniMaxH3HyperFlowP7ConditioningEXPT8
MiniMaxH3HyperFlowP7ConditioningEXPT8.display_name: H3 HyperFlow P7 · One Phase Native Conditions (T8 EXP)
MiniMaxH3HyperFlowP7ConditioningEXPT8.description: Prepare independently editable LOW or HIGH T2VA/native prompt and original P7 motion/audio conditions. HIGH receives the accepted motion reference without a new prefix lock. No sampling, MODEL patch, Relay or EAV is performed here; those require separate downstream stage nodes.

MiniMaxH3HyperFlowP7InitialSegmentEXPT8.name: MiniMaxH3HyperFlowP7InitialSegmentEXPT8
MiniMaxH3HyperFlowP7InitialSegmentEXPT8.display_name: H3 HyperFlow P7 · Select Empty Segment 0 (T8 EXP)
MiniMaxH3HyperFlowP7InitialSegmentEXPT8.description: Use the original P7 empty first-segment context on a new or still-empty chain. The context_frames widget selects later-segment capacity; actual segment 0 conditions use 0. Read-only; refuses an already accepted segment or a changed manifest. Does not create a chain, prepare VAE, or sample. Connect output to two independent phase conditions.

MiniMaxH3HyperFlowP7LowSetupEXPT8.name: MiniMaxH3HyperFlowP7LowSetupEXPT8
MiniMaxH3HyperFlowP7LowSetupEXPT8.display_name: H3 HyperFlow P7 · LOW 0:4 Setup Only (T8 EXP)
MiniMaxH3HyperFlowP7LowSetupEXPT8.description: Bind an independently selected Fresh HyperFlow MODEL/LoRA and LOW phase to the original long-video extra conditions and absolute 0:4 sampler. External positive may carry a paired Prompt Relay; protected motion guides cannot be replaced. Connect optional Stage EAV, Basic Guider, and ONE Stage Sampler. No sampling here.

MiniMaxH3HyperFlowP7LowResultEXPT8.name: MiniMaxH3HyperFlowP7LowResultEXPT8
MiniMaxH3HyperFlowP7LowResultEXPT8.display_name: H3 HyperFlow P7 · Bind Completed LOW Result (T8 EXP)
MiniMaxH3HyperFlowP7LowResultEXPT8.description: Verify the actual Stage Sampler 0:4 receipt came from this P7 phase, including the accepted parent and source tensor identity. Select the real denoised_output for external learned3D, not nonterminal output. A saved/loaded LOW Stage Result can be rebound for HIGH-only work after source revalidation. No sampling here.

MiniMaxH3HyperFlowP7LearnedLiftEXPT8.name: MiniMaxH3HyperFlowP7LearnedLiftEXPT8
MiniMaxH3HyperFlowP7LearnedLiftEXPT8.display_name: H3 HyperFlow P7 · Original Learned 3D Lift (T8 EXP)
MiniMaxH3HyperFlowP7LearnedLiftEXPT8.description: Run the original P7 target-dimensions learned3D on authenticated LOW denoised_output. Audio is preserved; this is a standalone upscale, not a diffusion stage.

MiniMaxH3HyperFlowP7HighHandoffEXPT8.name: MiniMaxH3HyperFlowP7HighHandoffEXPT8
MiniMaxH3HyperFlowP7HighHandoffEXPT8.display_name: H3 HyperFlow P7 · Original HIGH Audio Reconcile (T8 EXP)
MiniMaxH3HyperFlowP7HighHandoffEXPT8.description: Join a verified LOW learned lift with independently prepared HIGH reference conditions. Use the original audio policy: LOW coarse generated region, HIGH locked template region. External paired Relay may feed positive; protected motion guides must remain intact.

MiniMaxH3HyperFlowP7HighSetupEXPT8.name: MiniMaxH3HyperFlowP7HighSetupEXPT8
MiniMaxH3HyperFlowP7HighSetupEXPT8.display_name: H3 HyperFlow P7 · HIGH 4:8 Setup Only (T8 EXP)
MiniMaxH3HyperFlowP7HighSetupEXPT8.description: Patch the selected independent HIGH MODEL and build original absolute fresh 4:8 stage. Connect optional external Stage EAV, Basic Guider and ONE Stage Sampler.

MiniMaxH3HyperFlowP7HighResultEXPT8.name: MiniMaxH3HyperFlowP7HighResultEXPT8
MiniMaxH3HyperFlowP7HighResultEXPT8.display_name: H3 HyperFlow P7 · Bind Completed HIGH Result (T8 EXP)
MiniMaxH3HyperFlowP7HighResultEXPT8.description: Verify actual fresh 4:8 Stage Sampler completion and source identity. Output is the terminal joint AV; delivery/acceptance remains a separate explicit step.

MiniMaxH3HyperFlowP7LowSaveEXPT8.name: MiniMaxH3HyperFlowP7LowSaveEXPT8
MiniMaxH3HyperFlowP7LowSaveEXPT8.display_name: H3 HyperFlow P7 · Save Exact LOW 0:4 (T8 EXP)
MiniMaxH3HyperFlowP7LowSaveEXPT8.description: Write a new immutable P7-only LOW artifact. Output path and SHA are mandatory for explicit HIGH-only restoration; old HyperFlow cache and general stage store are not reused. Unknown executable stacks cannot claim portable restoration.

MiniMaxH3HyperFlowP7LowLoadEXPT8.name: MiniMaxH3HyperFlowP7LowLoadEXPT8
MiniMaxH3HyperFlowP7LowLoadEXPT8.display_name: H3 HyperFlow P7 · Load Exact LOW for HIGH Only (T8 EXP)
MiniMaxH3HyperFlowP7LowLoadEXPT8.description: Reload a selected completed LOW manifest by path and SHA under this chain/segment's separate P7 namespace. Recheck the accepted parent and freshly prepared LOW phase, but do not load a LOW MODEL, draw LOW noise or sample LOW. Frozen selection is not an automatic cache hit against edited LOW model/effects/noise settings.

MiniMaxH3HyperFlowP7HighSaveEXPT8.name: MiniMaxH3HyperFlowP7HighSaveEXPT8
MiniMaxH3HyperFlowP7HighSaveEXPT8.display_name: H3 HyperFlow P7 · Save Exact HIGH 4:8 (T8 EXP)
MiniMaxH3HyperFlowP7HighSaveEXPT8.description: Write a new immutable P7-only completed joint AV result with the exact handoff and sampler receipt. No old P7 cache migration or implicit segment acceptance.

MiniMaxH3HyperFlowP7HighLoadEXPT8.name: MiniMaxH3HyperFlowP7HighLoadEXPT8
MiniMaxH3HyperFlowP7HighLoadEXPT8.display_name: H3 HyperFlow P7 · Load Exact Completed HIGH (T8 EXP)
MiniMaxH3HyperFlowP7HighLoadEXPT8.description: Reload a selected completed HIGH manifest by path and SHA. Recheck current P7 parent, LOW lift, HIGH conditions and reconciled handoff; no diffusion run or implicit acceptance.

MiniMaxH3HyperFlowP7RelayProjectEXPT8.name: MiniMaxH3HyperFlowP7RelayProjectEXPT8
MiniMaxH3HyperFlowP7RelayProjectEXPT8.display_name: H3 HyperFlow P7 · External Relay Window (T8 EXP)
MiniMaxH3HyperFlowP7RelayProjectEXPT8.description: Project an external global Prompt Relay Plan onto the authenticated P7 segment's exact frame window. Connect compiled_prompt to either phase's Conditioning prompt. LOW/HIGH may use separate Plans; no MODEL patch or sampling here.

MiniMaxH3HyperFlowP7RelayApplyEXPT8.name: MiniMaxH3HyperFlowP7RelayApplyEXPT8
MiniMaxH3HyperFlowP7RelayApplyEXPT8.display_name: H3 HyperFlow P7 · Pair Relay to ONE Phase (T8 EXP)
MiniMaxH3HyperFlowP7RelayApplyEXPT8.description: Bind this P7 phase's original motion guides and projected Relay events to both MODEL and CONDITIONING. Apply before LOW/HIGH Setup, then optionally apply external Stage EAV after Setup. The completed Stage Result records actual Relay/EAV calls; an Apply node alone is not proof of execution.

MiniMaxH3HyperFlowP7StageEAVApplyEXPT8.name: MiniMaxH3HyperFlowP7StageEAVApplyEXPT8
MiniMaxH3HyperFlowP7StageEAVApplyEXPT8.display_name: H3 HyperFlow P7 · External Stage EAV for This Phase (T8 EXP)
MiniMaxH3HyperFlowP7StageEAVApplyEXPT8.description: Apply external Stage EAV with this authenticated P7 LOW/HIGH phase. The phase binds the original Long Video motion-keyframe layout; generic Stage EAV remains unchanged. Connect after phase Setup, and inspect the completed stage audit for actual calls.

MiniMaxH3HyperFlowP7CandidateSaveEXPT8.name: MiniMaxH3HyperFlowP7CandidateSaveEXPT8
MiniMaxH3HyperFlowP7CandidateSaveEXPT8.display_name: H3 HyperFlow P7 · Save Separate Candidate (T8 EXP)
MiniMaxH3HyperFlowP7CandidateSaveEXPT8.description: Decode the authenticated completed HIGH AV, trim the context, optionally color-match the accepted predecessor, and save an immutable candidate. A continuable segment also writes LOW video with completed HIGH audio and a 4+4 effects audit. This does not accept it.

MiniMaxH3HyperFlowP7CandidateAcceptEXPT8.name: MiniMaxH3HyperFlowP7CandidateAcceptEXPT8
MiniMaxH3HyperFlowP7CandidateAcceptEXPT8.display_name: H3 HyperFlow P7 · Review & Accept Separate Candidate (T8 EXP)
MiniMaxH3HyperFlowP7CandidateAcceptEXPT8.description: Default is preview only. Before explicit acceptance, verify candidate MP4/HIGH context, P7 LOW context with completed audio and the audit job SHA. Preserve old manifest rules, reject replacements and never auto-accept an incomplete candidate. Connect returned ID/revision/job SHA to the next Accepted Parent selection.

MiniMaxH3SPEEDStageSetupEXPT8.name: MiniMaxH3SPEEDStageSetupEXPT8
MiniMaxH3SPEEDStageSetupEXPT8.display_name: H3 SPEED · Prepare ONE Stage (T8 EXP)
MiniMaxH3SPEEDStageSetupEXPT8.description: Rebuilds exactly one planned H3 AV canvas/conditioning and its native-flow Euler schedule. Independent MODEL/LoRA branch per stage. The previous spec enables original T2VA text reuse; set reuse=false to rebuild edited stage text. No sampling or hidden fallback. External Stage EAV and SPEED Relay adapters are available. Explicit Save/Load accepts only completed stages with authenticated execution and effect-call evidence; automatic cache reuse is disabled.

MiniMaxH3SPEEDStageSampleEXPT8.name: MiniMaxH3SPEEDStageSampleEXPT8
MiniMaxH3SPEEDStageSampleEXPT8.display_name: H3 SPEED · Sample ONE Stage (T8 EXP)
MiniMaxH3SPEEDStageSampleEXPT8.description: Calls the native H3 Guider.sample once for this stage's sigmas. MODEL, CONDITIONING, SAMPLER and NOISE remain externally wired. Output is the public-flow state used by DCT Transition, not a decoded x0. A live result is not portable persistent cache proof.

MiniMaxH3SPEEDDCTTransitionEXPT8.name: MiniMaxH3SPEEDDCTTransitionEXPT8
MiniMaxH3SPEEDDCTTransitionEXPT8.display_name: H3 SPEED · DCT + AV Transition (T8 EXP)
MiniMaxH3SPEEDDCTTransitionEXPT8.description: Consumes one completed stage and the next independently prepared target. Official DCT high-frequency expansion plus H3 audio flow reindex; solves the next segment's NOISE. Does not sample or silently reuse old stages.

MiniMaxH3SPEEDRelayApplyEXPT8.name: MiniMaxH3SPEEDRelayApplyEXPT8
MiniMaxH3SPEEDRelayApplyEXPT8.display_name: H3 SPEED · External Relay for ONE Stage (T8 EXP)
MiniMaxH3SPEEDRelayApplyEXPT8.description: Re-encodes one external Prompt Relay Plan at this stage's exact canvas, checks the rebuilt AV target against Stage Setup, and binds MODEL with CONDITIONING. Connect its outputs to this stage's Sampler, optionally through Stage EAV Apply. Inspect downstream actual-call audit; this node alone is not effect execution proof.

MiniMaxH3SPEEDStageSaveEXPT8.name: MiniMaxH3SPEEDStageSaveEXPT8
MiniMaxH3SPEEDStageSaveEXPT8.display_name: H3 SPEED · Save ONE Frozen Stage (T8 EXP)
MiniMaxH3SPEEDStageSaveEXPT8.description: Writes a new immutable SPEED-only artifact by completed typed result. Returns an exact path and SHA for explicit later selection. No automatic cache lookup. Unknown MODEL, noise or effect stacks cannot claim portable restoration; authenticated external Stage EAV and SPEED Relay calls are supported.

MiniMaxH3SPEEDStageLoadEXPT8.name: MiniMaxH3SPEEDStageLoadEXPT8
MiniMaxH3SPEEDStageLoadEXPT8.display_name: H3 SPEED · Load Exact Previous Stage (T8 EXP)
MiniMaxH3SPEEDStageLoadEXPT8.description: Loads the selected completed previous stage by path+SHA under the SPEED-only store. Connect prior_spec to the next Stage Setup and completed_stage to DCT Transition; no previous MODEL, noise, conditioning encode or sampler runs. This freezes a selected past stage, not an automatic cache hit against edited past-stage settings.

MiniMaxH3ChunkedSourceSegmentEXPT8.name: MiniMaxH3ChunkedSourceSegmentEXPT8
MiniMaxH3ChunkedSourceSegmentEXPT8.display_name: H3 Chunked · Slice ONE First-Pass Segment (T8 EXP)
MiniMaxH3ChunkedSourceSegmentEXPT8.description: Extracts exactly one pre-upscale AV time segment from a supplied first-pass latent. Use its latent with an external learned upscaler, then a separate PASS2 stage. This node does not sample or prove the supplied first pass completed; v5 joint-4+4 uses a different global-upscale contract and is rejected.

MiniMaxH3ChunkedPass2PrepareEXPT8.name: MiniMaxH3ChunkedPass2PrepareEXPT8
MiniMaxH3ChunkedPass2PrepareEXPT8.display_name: H3 Chunked · Prepare Global PASS2 State (T8 EXP)
MiniMaxH3ChunkedPass2PrepareEXPT8.description: Prepares v1-v4 original full-source mask and once-only global noise before any PASS2 chunk. This is not sampling or a portable result. Use the same NOISE seed at PASS2. The source first pass must be separately completed; v5 has another contract.

MiniMaxH3ChunkedLearnedLiftEXPT8.name: MiniMaxH3ChunkedLearnedLiftEXPT8
MiniMaxH3ChunkedLearnedLiftEXPT8.display_name: H3 Chunked · Learned Lift ONE Segment (T8 EXP)
MiniMaxH3ChunkedLearnedLiftEXPT8.description: Runs exactly the legacy learned 3D latent upscaler on one sliced first-pass segment. The PASS2 model, conditions, noise and sampler remain external and independent. Does not sample or create a cache receipt.

MiniMaxH3ChunkedPass2SegmentEXPT8.name: MiniMaxH3ChunkedPass2SegmentEXPT8
MiniMaxH3ChunkedPass2SegmentEXPT8.display_name: H3 Chunked · Sample ONE PASS2 Segment (T8 EXP)
MiniMaxH3ChunkedPass2SegmentEXPT8.description: Samples only this v1-v4 upscaled time segment with independently wired PASS2 MODEL/CONDITIONING/NOISE/SAMPLER/SIGMAS. Keeps the original spatial tile and temporal merge math; pass the prior result for the next segment. Final segment output keeps the exact complete first-pass audio tensor. Stage-specific effects must be wired outside this node and actually audited; no automatic cache or portable result.

MiniMaxH3ChunkedPass2EAVApplyEXPT8.name: MiniMaxH3ChunkedPass2EAVApplyEXPT8
MiniMaxH3ChunkedPass2EAVApplyEXPT8.display_name: H3 Chunked · External PASS2 EAV (one tile, T8 EXP)
MiniMaxH3ChunkedPass2EAVApplyEXPT8.description: Bind an external Stage EAV Config to exactly one v1-v4 PASS2 segment. Currently accepts only full_frame_safe single-tile plans; multi-tile producer coverage is not certified. Connect the output MODEL to this segment's PASS2 and the runtime to the matching Chunked EAV Audit. The old graph is untouched.

MiniMaxH3ChunkedPass2EAVAuditEXPT8.name: MiniMaxH3ChunkedPass2EAVAuditEXPT8
MiniMaxH3ChunkedPass2EAVAuditEXPT8.display_name: H3 Chunked · PASS2 EAV Actual Calls (T8 EXP)
MiniMaxH3ChunkedPass2EAVAuditEXPT8.description: Audit the matching full_frame_safe segment's actual EAV forward/attention calls after PASS2. A graph connection alone is not proof of effect coverage.

MiniMaxH3ChunkedPass2RelayBindEXPT8.name: MiniMaxH3ChunkedPass2RelayBindEXPT8
MiniMaxH3ChunkedPass2RelayBindEXPT8.display_name: H3 Chunked · Bind External PASS2 Relay (T8 EXP)
MiniMaxH3ChunkedPass2RelayBindEXPT8.description: Pair the existing external Prompt Relay Plan/Conditioning MODEL, positive and AV template with exactly one v2-v4 full-clip/full-frame PASS2. Validates its native packed layout, model-condition hash and lifted target geometry. v1 temporal chunks and spatial multi-tile need separate local-layout adapters.

MiniMaxH3ChunkedPass2RelayAuditEXPT8.name: MiniMaxH3ChunkedPass2RelayAuditEXPT8
MiniMaxH3ChunkedPass2RelayAuditEXPT8.display_name: H3 Chunked · PASS2 Relay Actual Calls (T8 EXP)
MiniMaxH3ChunkedPass2RelayAuditEXPT8.description: Audit actual standalone Relay forward and routed-attention calls after this full-clip PASS2. Relay+EAV combined calls belong to the EAV audit.

MiniMaxH3ChunkedV5GlobalLiftEXPT8.name: MiniMaxH3ChunkedV5GlobalLiftEXPT8
MiniMaxH3ChunkedV5GlobalLiftEXPT8.display_name: H3 Chunked v5 · Global Learned Lift (T8 EXP)
MiniMaxH3ChunkedV5GlobalLiftEXPT8.description: Runs the original learned 3D upscaler exactly once on the complete partial4 denoised_output AV. Does not sample PASS2 or create a portable cache receipt.

MiniMaxH3ChunkedV5PrepareEXPT8.name: MiniMaxH3ChunkedV5PrepareEXPT8
MiniMaxH3ChunkedV5PrepareEXPT8.display_name: H3 Chunked v5 · Prepare Full AV Noise (T8 EXP)
MiniMaxH3ChunkedV5PrepareEXPT8.description: Draws global target video and audio noise once after the global learned lift. All PASS2 windows must consume this same typed live preparation.

MiniMaxH3ChunkedV5PASS2WindowEXPT8.name: MiniMaxH3ChunkedV5PASS2WindowEXPT8
MiniMaxH3ChunkedV5PASS2WindowEXPT8.display_name: H3 Chunked v5 · One Joint AV PASS2 Window (T8 EXP)
MiniMaxH3ChunkedV5PASS2WindowEXPT8.description: Runs exactly one standard remaining4 refine window with external MODEL, HIGH CONDITIONING, NOISE, SAMPLER and SIGMAS. Later windows require the prior typed result; final audio is refined joint AV, not first-pass passthrough. Cumulative intermediate outputs are not portable cache receipts.

MiniMaxH3ChunkedV5EAVApplyEXPT8.name: MiniMaxH3ChunkedV5EAVApplyEXPT8
MiniMaxH3ChunkedV5EAVApplyEXPT8.display_name: H3 Chunked v5 · External Window EAV (T8 EXP)
MiniMaxH3ChunkedV5EAVApplyEXPT8.description: Apply a separately editable Stage EAV Config to the exact joint AV PASS2 window, including locked video/audio overlap. Connect its MODEL to the matching PASS2 window and runtime to the audit. Relay composition is not yet qualified.

MiniMaxH3ChunkedV5EAVAuditEXPT8.name: MiniMaxH3ChunkedV5EAVAuditEXPT8
MiniMaxH3ChunkedV5EAVAuditEXPT8.display_name: H3 Chunked v5 · Window EAV Actual Calls (T8 EXP)
MiniMaxH3ChunkedV5EAVAuditEXPT8.description: Audit actual EAV calls after one matching joint AV PASS2 window. A connection alone does not certify effect coverage or image/audio quality.

MiniMaxH3ChunkedV5RelayProjectEXPT8.name: MiniMaxH3ChunkedV5RelayProjectEXPT8
MiniMaxH3ChunkedV5RelayProjectEXPT8.display_name: H3 Chunked v5 · Project External Relay to Window (T8 EXP)
MiniMaxH3ChunkedV5RelayProjectEXPT8.description: Authenticate a full-clip external Prompt Relay Plan/Conditioning pair, then project its event coordinates and packed AV layout to one actual v5 PASS2 window. The 136-frame first window cannot use an unprojected 141-frame aligned Relay layout. Connect both projected MODEL and CONDITIONING to PASS2.

MiniMaxH3ChunkedV5RelayAuditEXPT8.name: MiniMaxH3ChunkedV5RelayAuditEXPT8
MiniMaxH3ChunkedV5RelayAuditEXPT8.display_name: H3 Chunked v5 · Window Relay Actual Calls (T8 EXP)
MiniMaxH3ChunkedV5RelayAuditEXPT8.description: Audit actual routed Relay attention calls after the matching v5 PASS2 window. This standalone audit does not certify Relay+EAV composition.

MiniMaxH3H16Pass2PlanEXPT8.name: MiniMaxH3H16Pass2PlanEXPT8
MiniMaxH3H16Pass2PlanEXPT8.description: Builds the old H16 v4 full-frame plan from the already completed HIGH input. It does not sample. Connect the same source to Chunked Source/Prepare, then one independent PASS2 node per temporal window.

MiniMaxH3H16Pass2WindowEXPT8.name: MiniMaxH3H16Pass2WindowEXPT8
MiniMaxH3H16Pass2WindowEXPT8.display_name: H16-3 · Sample ONE PASS2 Window (T8 EXP)
MiniMaxH3H16Pass2WindowEXPT8.description: Samples one explicit v4 H16 full-frame PASS2 window with external editable MODEL/positive/NOISE/SAMPLER/SIGMAS. The previous window is a typed input. At the final window, refined_exp applies the old absolute-time audio crossfade/quiet-tail policy; merge failure retains first-pass audio. The denoised_output of the old node was only an output alias, not x0.

MiniMaxH3H16EAVApplyEXPT8.name: MiniMaxH3H16EAVApplyEXPT8
MiniMaxH3H16EAVApplyEXPT8.description: Bind a separately editable EAV config to one exact H16 PASS2 window, including the inherited video mask and prior-window guarded overlap. Connect the MODEL to that window and audit its actual calls. External Relay composition requires a separate local projection.

MiniMaxH3H16EAVAuditEXPT8.name: MiniMaxH3H16EAVAuditEXPT8
MiniMaxH3H16EAVAuditEXPT8.display_name: H16-3 · Window EAV Actual Calls (T8 EXP)
MiniMaxH3H16EAVAuditEXPT8.description: Audit actual EAV forward and attention calls after this exact H16 window. Returns the H16-selected final audio, not the core video's first-pass-audio intermediate. Connection alone proves no effect.

MiniMaxH3H16RelayProjectEXPT8.name: MiniMaxH3H16RelayProjectEXPT8
MiniMaxH3H16RelayProjectEXPT8.display_name: H16-3 · Project External Relay to Window (T8 EXP)
MiniMaxH3H16RelayProjectEXPT8.description: Authenticate a full-clip external Relay MODEL/CONDITIONING pair and project its timeline/layout to one exact guarded H16 PASS2 window. Pass both returned MODEL and positive CONDITIONING to that window.

MiniMaxH3H16RelayAuditEXPT8.name: MiniMaxH3H16RelayAuditEXPT8
MiniMaxH3H16RelayAuditEXPT8.display_name: H16-3 · Window Relay Actual Calls (T8 EXP)
MiniMaxH3H16RelayAuditEXPT8.description: Audit routed attention and completed forwards for a standalone projected H16 Relay window. For Relay+EAV use the EAV joint audit.

MiniMaxH3H16WindowSaveEXPT8.name: MiniMaxH3H16WindowSaveEXPT8
MiniMaxH3H16WindowSaveEXPT8.description: Explicitly save one completed H16 PASS2 window with its cumulative video and audio history. Copy both returned manifest path and exact SHA. This freezes the selected result; it is not automatic MODEL/conditioning cache reuse.

MiniMaxH3H16WindowLoadEXPT8.name: MiniMaxH3H16WindowLoadEXPT8
MiniMaxH3H16WindowLoadEXPT8.display_name: H16-3 · Load Exact Frozen Window (T8 EXP)
MiniMaxH3H16WindowLoadEXPT8.description: Load an explicitly selected completed H16 window by exact manifest SHA. Rechecks the current source, plan and window number, then restores the typed result for the next window without sampling prior windows. Changed MODEL/conditioning is not treated as an automatic cache hit.

MiniMaxH3FaceStageBindEXPT8.name: MiniMaxH3FaceStageBindEXPT8
MiniMaxH3FaceStageBindEXPT8.display_name: H3 Face · Bind Separate Refinement Stage (T8 EXP)
MiniMaxH3FaceStageBindEXPT8.description: Bind existing Face Plan/source and isolated low-denoise MODEL/SAMPLER/SIGMAS to one editable stage. No sampling, VAE encoding or stitching. Standard Face Plan only; other Face variants require separate adapters.

MiniMaxH3FaceStageAuditEXPT8.name: MiniMaxH3FaceStageAuditEXPT8
MiniMaxH3FaceStageAuditEXPT8.display_name: H3 Face · Source-Bound Stage Audit (T8 EXP)
MiniMaxH3FaceStageAuditEXPT8.description: After Stage Sampler/Load, check actual candidate receipt against current Face Plan, source frames and input AV before the existing Stitch node. Input audio mask lock does not guarantee bit-exact sampled audio; deliver the original source audio separately. Does not automatically approve or replace the candidate.

MiniMaxH3FaceParityStageBindEXPT8.name: MiniMaxH3FaceParityStageBindEXPT8
MiniMaxH3FaceParityStageBindEXPT8.display_name: H3 Face Parity · Bind Separate Stage (T8 EXP)
MiniMaxH3FaceParityStageBindEXPT8.description: Bind the existing Parity Plan and currently connected MODEL/SAMPLER/SIGMAS/AV. Keeps per-frame denoise and optional sampler-mask patch external. Exact-source default Core er_sde can certify completion; unknown samplers run without portable identity.

MiniMaxH3FaceParityStageAuditEXPT8.name: MiniMaxH3FaceParityStageAuditEXPT8
MiniMaxH3FaceParityStageAuditEXPT8.display_name: H3 Face Parity · Source-Bound Audit (T8 EXP)
MiniMaxH3FaceParityStageAuditEXPT8.description: Check a sampled Parity/Per-Frame/Sampler-Mask candidate against the current plan, source frames and input AV. Keep original source audio for delivery. Unknown sampler completion stays unverified; no automatic acceptance or quality claim.

MiniMaxH3MultiFaceStageBindEXPT8.name: MiniMaxH3MultiFaceStageBindEXPT8
MiniMaxH3MultiFaceStageBindEXPT8.display_name: H3 Multi-Face · Bind One Character Stage (T8 EXP)
MiniMaxH3MultiFaceStageBindEXPT8.description: Bind one multi-person repair job, its model window and unchanged parent source to a separate sampled stage. Verify absolute window/padding and actual external MODEL, SAMPLER, SIGMAS and AV; each character needs its own instance. Does not auto-accept.

MiniMaxH3MultiFaceStageAuditEXPT8.name: MiniMaxH3MultiFaceStageAuditEXPT8
MiniMaxH3MultiFaceStageAuditEXPT8.display_name: H3 Multi-Face · Source-Bound Candidate Audit (T8 EXP)
MiniMaxH3MultiFaceStageAuditEXPT8.description: Before Parity Stitch and sequential Composite, verify that this sampled character candidate belongs to the same job window, unchanged parent and source AV. Unknown sampler completion is not portable or automatically accepted.

MiniMaxH3FaceWindowStageBindEXPT8.name: MiniMaxH3FaceWindowStageBindEXPT8
MiniMaxH3FaceWindowStageBindEXPT8.display_name: H3 Face Window · Bind Separate Stage (T8 EXP)
MiniMaxH3FaceWindowStageBindEXPT8.description: Bind one extracted repair window to its parent frames, signed window plan/mapping and original/window audio before a separate Parity sampler stage. The Manual and Studio review/commit nodes remain external; no automatic acceptance or delivery.

MiniMaxH3FaceWindowStageAuditEXPT8.name: MiniMaxH3FaceWindowStageAuditEXPT8
MiniMaxH3FaceWindowStageAuditEXPT8.display_name: H3 Face Window · Source-Bound Candidate Audit (T8 EXP)
MiniMaxH3FaceWindowStageAuditEXPT8.description: Before crop decode and Manual/Studio review, verify the sampled candidate still belongs to the current parent source, repair window, frame map and original/window audio. The sampled audio latent is not the delivered source track; no quality approval.

MiniMaxH3MotionStageBindEXPT8.name: MiniMaxH3MotionStageBindEXPT8
MiniMaxH3MotionStageBindEXPT8.display_name: H3 Motion Recovery · Bind Separate Pass 2 (T8 EXP)
MiniMaxH3MotionStageBindEXPT8.description: Bind the signed motion plan, original frames/audio, expanded frames/audio seed, actual AV and external MODEL/SAMPLER/SIGMAS before one independent refinement pass. Does not run a VAE, sampler, phase vocoder or delivery decision.

MiniMaxH3MotionStageAuditEXPT8.name: MiniMaxH3MotionStageAuditEXPT8
MiniMaxH3MotionStageAuditEXPT8.display_name: H3 Motion Recovery · Audit Pass 2 Candidate (T8 EXP)
MiniMaxH3MotionStageAuditEXPT8.description: Before Recover AV and optional Window Collect/Gate, recheck that the sampled candidate belongs to the current motion plan and exact connected source/retimed AV. Original pass-1 audio remains the safe delivery default; no quality approval.

MiniMaxH3MotionRelayLengthEXPT8.name: MiniMaxH3MotionRelayLengthEXPT8
MiniMaxH3MotionRelayLengthEXPT8.display_name: H3 Motion Recovery · Retimed Relay Length (T8 EXP)
MiniMaxH3MotionRelayLengthEXPT8.description: Expose the signed expanded H3 frame count to an independent Prompt Relay Plan. Rejects abstain and unaligned timelines; no model call or sampling.

MiniMaxH3MotionRelayBindEXPT8.name: MiniMaxH3MotionRelayBindEXPT8
MiniMaxH3MotionRelayBindEXPT8.display_name: H3 Motion Recovery · Bind External Prompt Relay (T8 EXP)
MiniMaxH3MotionRelayBindEXPT8.description: Pair the stock external Relay MODEL/CONDITIONING with the signed retimed pass-2 AV. Relay's generated AV is used only to authenticate the packed layout, never to replace Motion's VAE/phase-vocoder source. Connect Stage EAV Config→Apply→Audit separately to observe actual calls.

MiniMaxH3AudioRefineDualClockStageBindEX.name: MiniMaxH3AudioRefineDualClockStageBindEXPT8
MiniMaxH3AudioRefineDualClockStageBindEX.display_name: H3 Audio Refine dual_clock · Bind Separate Tail (T8 EXP)
MiniMaxH3AudioRefineDualClockStageBindEX.description: Check signed Plan, existing Setup controls, original AV and exact 0-video/1-audio mask without changing MODEL/NOISE/GUIDER/SAMPLER/SIGMAS. Empty-SIGMAS abstain remains a no-sample path. No automatic cache or quality approval.

MiniMaxH3AudioRefineDualClockStageAuditE.name: MiniMaxH3AudioRefineDualClockStageAuditEXPT8
MiniMaxH3AudioRefineDualClockStageAuditE.display_name: H3 Audio Refine · Audit Separate Tail Candidate (T8 EXP)
MiniMaxH3AudioRefineDualClockStageAuditE.description: Recheck source and signed stage boundary after the existing external sampler. ABSTAIN must return original AV unchanged. Candidate audio is not accepted here; the existing Quality Gate and human listening remain authoritative.

MiniMaxH3AudioRefineDualModelStageBindEX.name: MiniMaxH3AudioRefineDualModelStageBindEXPT8
MiniMaxH3AudioRefineDualModelStageBindEX.display_name: H3 Audio Refine dual_model · Bind Separate Tail (T8 EXP)
MiniMaxH3AudioRefineDualModelStageBindEX.description: Check signed Plan, existing Setup controls, original AV and exact 0-video/1-audio mask without changing MODEL/NOISE/GUIDER/SAMPLER/SIGMAS. Empty-SIGMAS abstain remains a no-sample path. No automatic cache or quality approval.

MiniMaxH3AudioRefineDualModelStageAuditE.name: MiniMaxH3AudioRefineDualModelStageAuditEXPT8
MiniMaxH3AudioRefineDualModelStageAuditE.display_name: H3 Audio Refine · Audit Separate Tail Candidate (T8 EXP)
MiniMaxH3AudioRefineDualModelStageAuditE.description: Recheck source and signed stage boundary after the existing external sampler. ABSTAIN must return original AV unchanged. Candidate audio is not accepted here; the existing Quality Gate and human listening remain authoritative.

MiniMaxH3AudioRefineCompatStageBindEXPT8.name: MiniMaxH3AudioRefineCompatStageBindEXPT8
MiniMaxH3AudioRefineCompatStageBindEXPT8.display_name: H3 Audio Refine compatibility · Bind Separate Tail (T8 EXP)
MiniMaxH3AudioRefineCompatStageBindEXPT8.description: Check signed Plan, existing Setup controls, original AV and exact 0-video/1-audio mask without changing MODEL/NOISE/GUIDER/SAMPLER/SIGMAS. Empty-SIGMAS abstain remains a no-sample path. No automatic cache or quality approval.

MiniMaxH3AudioRefineCompatStageAuditEXPT.name: MiniMaxH3AudioRefineCompatStageAuditEXPT8
MiniMaxH3AudioRefineCompatStageAuditEXPT.display_name: H3 Audio Refine · Audit Separate Tail Candidate (T8 EXP)
MiniMaxH3AudioRefineCompatStageAuditEXPT.description: Recheck source and signed stage boundary after the existing external sampler. ABSTAIN must return original AV unchanged. Candidate audio is not accepted here; the existing Quality Gate and human listening remain authoritative.

MiniMaxH3AudioRefineTailDeliveryAuditEXP.name: MiniMaxH3AudioRefineTailDeliveryAuditEXPT8
MiniMaxH3AudioRefineTailDeliveryAuditEXP.display_name: H3 Audio Refine · Audit Sample or Abstain (T8 EXP)
MiniMaxH3AudioRefineTailDeliveryAuditEXP.description: For sampled tails, run the original strict two-pass audio audit unchanged. For signed ABSTAIN tails, require exact original AV and pass it through without inventing a sampling mask or claiming an accepted candidate.

MiniMaxH3LTXRGBStageBindEXPT8.name: MiniMaxH3LTXRGBStageBindEXPT8
MiniMaxH3LTXRGBStageBindEXPT8.display_name: H3→LTX RGB · Bind Separate Refiner (T8 EXP)
MiniMaxH3LTXRGBStageBindEXPT8.description: Bind H3 RGB preparation, original audio bypass, learned LTX lift and the external refiner MODEL/NOISE/GUIDER/SAMPLER/SIGMAS. No sampling or cache claim.

MiniMaxH3LTXRGBStageAuditEXPT8.name: MiniMaxH3LTXRGBStageAuditEXPT8
MiniMaxH3LTXRGBStageAuditEXPT8.display_name: H3→LTX RGB · Audit Refiner Candidate (T8 EXP)
MiniMaxH3LTXRGBStageAuditEXPT8.description: Recheck current H3 source/audio, RGB→LTX handoff and connected sampler controls before separate TAEHV decode. Pass the original H3 AUDIO object through unchanged; this is not a portable receipt or a quality decision.

MiniMaxH3PreparedLTXGenerateEXPT8.name: MiniMaxH3PreparedLTXGenerateEXPT8
MiniMaxH3PreparedLTXGenerateEXPT8.display_name: Prepared LTX · Generate Refined Latent (T8 EXP)
MiniMaxH3PreparedLTXGenerateEXPT8.description: Run only the prepared LTX refinement worker. Commit a SHA-bound latent receipt; never start VAE decode or implicitly run another sampler.

MiniMaxH3PreparedLTXLoadGenerationEXPT8.name: MiniMaxH3PreparedLTXLoadGenerationEXPT8
MiniMaxH3PreparedLTXLoadGenerationEXPT8.display_name: Prepared LTX · Load Frozen Refined Latent (T8 EXP)
MiniMaxH3PreparedLTXLoadGenerationEXPT8.description: Explicitly load a committed generation SHA after a restart. No GPU worker, sampling or decode is started; current bundle/seed/engine identity must match.

MiniMaxH3PreparedLTXDecodeEXPT8.name: MiniMaxH3PreparedLTXDecodeEXPT8
MiniMaxH3PreparedLTXDecodeEXPT8.display_name: Prepared LTX · Decode Frozen Latent (T8 EXP)
MiniMaxH3PreparedLTXDecodeEXPT8.description: Run only the LTX VAE/movie worker from a matching committed latent receipt. Original audio is retained by the existing worker; generation is never implicit.

MiniMaxH3LTXLearnedStageBindEXPT8.name: MiniMaxH3LTXLearnedStageBindEXPT8
MiniMaxH3LTXLearnedStageBindEXPT8.display_name: H3→LTX Learned · Bind Separate Refiner (T8 EXP)
MiniMaxH3LTXLearnedStageBindEXPT8.description: Bind the actual learned H3 video-latent adapter output and original H3 AV to an external LTX MODEL/NOISE/GUIDER/SAMPLER/SIGMAS. No RGB bridge, second upscaler, sampling or portable cache claim.

MiniMaxH3LTXLearnedStageAuditEXPT8.name: MiniMaxH3LTXLearnedStageAuditEXPT8
MiniMaxH3LTXLearnedStageAuditEXPT8.display_name: H3→LTX Learned · Audit Refiner Candidate (T8 EXP)
MiniMaxH3LTXLearnedStageAuditEXPT8.description: Recheck source H3 AV, learned adapter geometry and connected LTX sampler before separate video/audio decode. Does not prove external sampler execution.

MiniMaxH3LTXOriginalAudioDecodeEXPT8.name: MiniMaxH3LTXOriginalAudioDecodeEXPT8
MiniMaxH3LTXOriginalAudioDecodeEXPT8.display_name: H3→LTX Learned · Decode Original H3 Audio (T8 EXP)
MiniMaxH3LTXOriginalAudioDecodeEXPT8.description: Decode only the original H3 joint-AV audio latent with the H3 Audio VAE. Never convert it to LTX audio or decode the H3 video again. Video-only H3 inputs fail explicitly.

MiniMaxH3FastH3V2CompletedLowX0EXPT8.name: MiniMaxH3FastH3V2CompletedLowX0EXPT8
MiniMaxH3FastH3V2CompletedLowX0EXPT8.display_name: FastH3 V2 · Completed LOW x0 for Learned Handoff (T8 EXP)
MiniMaxH3FastH3V2CompletedLowX0EXPT8.description: Verify the actual completed V2 LOW 0:4 StageResult and expose its denoised prediction_x0, never unfinished x_sigma. Connect the output to the existing learned 3D latent upscaler, then external reconcile and HIGH 4:8. Accepts an exact frozen LOW result for HIGH-only resume; no sampling here.

MiniMaxH3StageUNETLoaderAfterEXPT8.name: MiniMaxH3StageUNETLoaderAfterEXPT8
MiniMaxH3StageUNETLoaderAfterEXPT8.display_name: H3 Stage · Independent UNET Load After Result (T8 EXP)
MiniMaxH3StageUNETLoaderAfterEXPT8.description: Wait for a verified completed stage, then independently load this stage's diffusion model through Core UNETLoader. Identical bare loader nodes may be deduplicated by Core; a MODEL clone still shares the live network. This node keeps HIGH MODEL/LoRA editable without hidden sampling, but may consume extra CPU/RAM/VRAM until the earlier model is released. Connect a frozen StageLoad result for HIGH-only resume.

MiniMaxH3AudioRefineFrozenFirstPassLoadE.name: MiniMaxH3AudioRefineFrozenFirstPassLoadEXPT8
MiniMaxH3AudioRefineFrozenFirstPassLoadE.display_name: H3 Audio Refine · Load Verified First Pass (T8 EXP)
MiniMaxH3AudioRefineFrozenFirstPassLoadE.description: Load only a complete native H3 AV checkpoint whose explicit external manifest, whole-file SHA-256 and audio_refine_firstpass ID match. Empty evidence fails before any tail sampling.

MiniMaxH3AudioRefineFrozenAVFrameGuardEX.name: MiniMaxH3AudioRefineFrozenAVFrameGuardEXPT8
MiniMaxH3AudioRefineFrozenAVFrameGuardEX.display_name: H3 Audio Refine · Match Frozen Video Frames (T8 EXP)
MiniMaxH3AudioRefineFrozenAVFrameGuardEX.description: Fail before audio refinement when the verified frozen H3 AV does not have this workflow's expected video frame count.

MiniMaxH3AudioRefineContextCommitGateEXP.name: MiniMaxH3AudioRefineContextCommitGateEXPT8
MiniMaxH3AudioRefineContextCommitGateEXP.display_name: H3 Audio Refine · Commit Long Context After Freeze (T8 EXP)
MiniMaxH3AudioRefineContextCommitGateEXP.description: Only let the original long-video context saver write after the frozen native AV checkpoint has been explicitly saved and verified.

MiniMaxH3ChunkedV1RelayProjectEXPT8.name: MiniMaxH3ChunkedV1RelayProjectEXPT8
MiniMaxH3ChunkedV1RelayProjectEXPT8.display_name: H3 Chunked v1 · Project Relay to ONE Segment (T8 EXP)
MiniMaxH3ChunkedV1RelayProjectEXPT8.description: Project a stock full-clip Prompt Relay Plan/Conditioning onto one native v1 temporal segment, including the previous completed segment's anchor. Requires full_frame_safe and locked input audio; spatial tiles have no Relay certification. Connect a separate instance before each PASS2 segment.

MiniMaxH3ChunkedV1RelayAuditEXPT8.name: MiniMaxH3ChunkedV1RelayAuditEXPT8
MiniMaxH3ChunkedV1RelayAuditEXPT8.display_name: H3 Chunked v1 · Segment Relay Actual Calls (T8 EXP)
MiniMaxH3ChunkedV1RelayAuditEXPT8.description: Audit the paired local Relay MODEL's actual forwards/routed attention after exactly one v1 PASS2 segment. Relay+EAV combined calls belong to the EAV audit, not this standalone report.

MiniMaxH3ChunkedV1SegmentSaveEXPT8.name: MiniMaxH3ChunkedV1SegmentSaveEXPT8
MiniMaxH3ChunkedV1SegmentSaveEXPT8.display_name: H3 Chunked v1 · Freeze ONE Segment (T8 EXP)
MiniMaxH3ChunkedV1SegmentSaveEXPT8.description: Explicitly freeze one completed v1 cumulative video and its original full-audio identity. Copy the returned manifest path and exact SHA. This is not automatic MODEL/conditioning cache reuse. Writing is off by default.

MiniMaxH3ChunkedV1SegmentLoadEXPT8.name: MiniMaxH3ChunkedV1SegmentLoadEXPT8
MiniMaxH3ChunkedV1SegmentLoadEXPT8.display_name: H3 Chunked v1 · Load Exact Frozen Segment (T8 EXP)
MiniMaxH3ChunkedV1SegmentLoadEXPT8.description: Load the explicitly selected completed v1 segment by exact manifest SHA. Recheck the current source/plan/segment and rebind current original full audio. The next segment can run without resampling the frozen one; changed MODEL or CONDITIONING is not treated as an automatic cache hit.

MiniMaxH3ChunkedV5WindowSaveEXPT8.name: MiniMaxH3ChunkedV5WindowSaveEXPT8
MiniMaxH3ChunkedV5WindowSaveEXPT8.display_name: H3 Chunked v5 · Freeze ONE Joint AV Window (T8 EXP)
MiniMaxH3ChunkedV5WindowSaveEXPT8.description: Explicitly freeze one completed v5 PASS2 window with cumulative joint AV. Copy both manifest path and exact SHA. This is not automatic MODEL/condition cache reuse.

MiniMaxH3ChunkedV5WindowLoadEXPT8.name: MiniMaxH3ChunkedV5WindowLoadEXPT8
MiniMaxH3ChunkedV5WindowLoadEXPT8.display_name: H3 Chunked v5 · Load Exact Frozen Window (T8 EXP)
MiniMaxH3ChunkedV5WindowLoadEXPT8.description: Load an explicitly selected completed v5 window by exact manifest SHA. Recheck current source, global lift, prepared noise, plan and window number; later windows may run without prior-window sampling. Today's MODEL/conditioning is not claimed equivalent to the frozen execution.

MiniMaxH3ChunkedV5VerifiedNativeSourceEX.name: MiniMaxH3ChunkedV5VerifiedNativeSourceEXPT8
MiniMaxH3ChunkedV5VerifiedNativeSourceEX.display_name: H3 Chunked v5 · Verify Native Partial4 Source (T8 EXP)
MiniMaxH3ChunkedV5VerifiedNativeSourceEX.description: Connect every receipt output of the native AV checkpoint Load. Recheck its external manifest, then remove only Load provenance so the original partial4 source identity can bind v5 windows.

MiniMaxH3H16VerifiedNativeSourceEXPT8.name: MiniMaxH3H16VerifiedNativeSourceEXPT8
MiniMaxH3H16VerifiedNativeSourceEXPT8.display_name: H16-3 · Verified Native Resume Source (T8 EXP)
MiniMaxH3H16VerifiedNativeSourceEXPT8.description: Require a native AV checkpoint's exact external manifest and file SHA before removing only its volatile Load provenance for H16 window identity. Never samples or decodes media.

MiniMaxH3LTXLearnedStageSampleEXPT8.name: MiniMaxH3LTXLearnedStageSampleEXPT8
MiniMaxH3LTXLearnedStageSampleEXPT8.display_name: H3→LTX Learned · Sample Separate Refiner (T8 EXP)
MiniMaxH3LTXLearnedStageSampleEXPT8.description: Execute one native Core LTX sampler call with external noise, guider, sampler and sigmas; return live-only evidence of three step callbacks.

MiniMaxH3LTXLearnedStageCertifiedAuditEX.name: MiniMaxH3LTXLearnedStageCertifiedAuditEXPT8
MiniMaxH3LTXLearnedStageCertifiedAuditEX.display_name: H3→LTX Learned · Audit Completed Refiner (T8 EXP)
MiniMaxH3LTXLearnedStageCertifiedAuditEX.description: Recheck the old source-bound candidate contract and require the matching live Stage Sample proof. No portable cache or quality claim.

MiniMaxH3MotionFrozenFirstPassLoadEXPT8.name: MiniMaxH3MotionFrozenFirstPassLoadEXPT8
MiniMaxH3MotionFrozenFirstPassLoadEXPT8.display_name: H3 Motion Recovery · Load Verified First Pass (T8 EXP)
MiniMaxH3MotionFrozenFirstPassLoadEXPT8.description: Explicit cold Motion source. Requires an independently retained native AV manifest and whole-file SHA, exact first-pass ID and original H3 geometry. Never samples or silently accepts a different frozen source.

MiniMaxH3FastH3V2AcceptedContextEXPT8.name: MiniMaxH3FastH3V2AcceptedContextEXPT8
MiniMaxH3FastH3V2AcceptedContextEXPT8.display_name: FastH3 V2 · Accepted LOW / HIGH Context Port (T8 EXP)
MiniMaxH3FastH3V2AcceptedContextEXPT8.description: Expose one authenticated accepted-parent context to separate native Long Video or Prompt Relay conditioning. LOW is accepted RGB24 resized and VAE-encoded; HIGH is the completed AV tail. No hidden sampler or HIGH dependency on LOW conditions.

MiniMaxH3FastH3V2AcceptedHighPrefixEXPT8.name: MiniMaxH3FastH3V2AcceptedHighPrefixEXPT8
MiniMaxH3FastH3V2AcceptedHighPrefixEXPT8.display_name: FastH3 V2 · Accepted HIGH Prefix After Reconcile (T8 EXP)
MiniMaxH3FastH3V2AcceptedHighPrefixEXPT8.description: Apply the old V2 continuation HIGH video prefix and optional three-step mask ramp only after separate learned upscale/reconcile. Keeps the same completed-context source and the reconciled audio tensor; no sampling or delivery is hidden here.

MiniMaxH3FastH3V2AcceptedRelayProjectEXP.name: MiniMaxH3FastH3V2AcceptedRelayProjectEXPT8
MiniMaxH3FastH3V2AcceptedRelayProjectEXP.display_name: FastH3 V2 · Accepted Timeline Relay Window (T8 EXP)
MiniMaxH3FastH3V2AcceptedRelayProjectEXP.description: Project an external global Relay plan using the selected accepted parent's exact timeline; output plugs into separate LOW/HIGH native Long Video Relay conditioning. Requires Dense EXP when Relay is active on V2; trained VSA has no bias adapter yet.

MiniMaxH3FastH3V2AcceptedReconcileEXPT8.name: MiniMaxH3FastH3V2AcceptedReconcileEXPT8
MiniMaxH3FastH3V2AcceptedReconcileEXPT8.display_name: FastH3 V2 · Accepted Joint-Audio Reconcile (T8 EXP)
MiniMaxH3FastH3V2AcceptedReconcileEXPT8.description: Reproduce the old V2 4+4 continuation legacy-policy audio selection from the learned LOW x0 and fresh HIGH template. Keep separate HIGH prefix node AFTER this reconcile; no hidden sampler or audio-freeze shortcut.

MiniMaxH3FastH3V2AcceptedWindowEXPT8.name: MiniMaxH3FastH3V2AcceptedWindowEXPT8
MiniMaxH3FastH3V2AcceptedWindowEXPT8.display_name: FastH3 V2 · Accepted Remainder Window (T8 EXP)
MiniMaxH3FastH3V2AcceptedWindowEXPT8.description: Choose a compact 90-frame remainder or the old loop's fixed 124-frame second render window. Both trim the same 22-context + 68-new delivery; the fixed variant discards a 34-frame suffix. Geometry only; no sampler.

MiniMaxH3FastH3V2AcceptedDeliveryWindowE.name: MiniMaxH3FastH3V2AcceptedDeliveryWindowEXPT8
MiniMaxH3FastH3V2AcceptedDeliveryWindowE.display_name: FastH3 V2 · Accepted Remainder Delivery Port (T8 EXP)
MiniMaxH3FastH3V2AcceptedDeliveryWindowE.description: Expose the authenticated parent identity and exact final-window AV trim coordinates. For 124+22+68, trim decoded frame 22 onward to 68 fresh frames. Does not trim, save a candidate, accept it or certify the current edited job contract.

MiniMaxH3FastH3V2CurrentRecipeEXPT8.name: MiniMaxH3FastH3V2CurrentRecipeEXPT8
MiniMaxH3FastH3V2CurrentRecipeEXPT8.display_name: FastH3 V2 · Current Editable Recipe Fingerprint (T8 EXP)
MiniMaxH3FastH3V2CurrentRecipeEXPT8.description: Hash the CURRENT two raw MODEL/LoRA branches, CLIP/VAEs, first frame, global Relay plans, external EAV configs and learned-upscaler bytes. This is not the previous accepted job SHA and does NOT attest stage execution, save a candidate or authorize acceptance.

MiniMaxH3FastH3V2CurrentStageAttestEXPT8.name: MiniMaxH3FastH3V2CurrentStageAttestEXPT8
MiniMaxH3FastH3V2CurrentStageAttestEXPT8.display_name: FastH3 V2 · Verify One Current Stage (T8 EXP)
MiniMaxH3FastH3V2CurrentStageAttestEXPT8.description: Compare one completed LOW/HIGH StageResult against the current raw MODEL/LoRA, actual sampler MODEL/guider/noise/source/sigmas, projected Relay and EAV. Does not accept or save a segment; both stages and parent delivery require separate gates.

model.tooltip: 未接其他补丁的原生 MiniMax H3 MODEL。

clip.tooltip: 原生 MiniMax H3 Qwen3-VL CLIP。

prompt_relay_plan.tooltip: 必须来自同段 Long Video Window 节点。

execution_mode.tooltip: 先 report_only；确认报告后再显式切到 apply_exp。

MiniMaxH3FastH3V2ConditionProvenanceEXPT.name: MiniMaxH3FastH3V2ConditionProvenanceEXPT8
MiniMaxH3FastH3V2ConditionProvenanceEXPT.display_name: FastH3 V2 · Long Video Relay Conditions + Origin (T8 EXP)
MiniMaxH3FastH3V2ConditionProvenanceEXPT.description: Call the unchanged native Long Video Relay conditioner once, adding a typed origin receipt for actual CLIP/VAEs, first frame, projected plan and output conditions. This alone does not certify a HIGH handoff or accepted parent.

MiniMaxH3FastH3V2OriginStageAttestEXPT8.name: MiniMaxH3FastH3V2OriginStageAttestEXPT8
MiniMaxH3FastH3V2OriginStageAttestEXPT8.display_name: FastH3 V2 · Verify Stage + Condition Origin (T8 EXP)
MiniMaxH3FastH3V2OriginStageAttestEXPT8.description: Require the same executed condition call's typed origin receipt and latent, then bind its CLIP/VAEs/first frame/positive to the completed sampler. Does not certify HIGH handoff, accepted parent, candidate save or assembly.

aspect_policy.tooltip: preserve_source is the safe default. honor_dimensions_exp permits different X/Y scales but still enforces max_anisotropy.

release_policy.tooltip: offload_after keeps a CPU cache but releases GPU weights; clear_after also removes the CPU cache; keep_loaded is opt-in and retains GPU memory.

MiniMaxH3FastH3V2UpscaleProvenanceEXPT8.name: MiniMaxH3FastH3V2UpscaleProvenanceEXPT8
MiniMaxH3FastH3V2UpscaleProvenanceEXPT8.display_name: FastH3 V2 · Learned 3D Upscale + Origin (T8 EXP)
MiniMaxH3FastH3V2UpscaleProvenanceEXPT8.description: Execute the unchanged learned 3D upscaler once and attach a typed input/output/report receipt. No second upscale or HIGH sampling runs here.

MiniMaxH3FastH3V2CurrentHandoffAttestEXP.name: MiniMaxH3FastH3V2CurrentHandoffAttestEXPT8
MiniMaxH3FastH3V2CurrentHandoffAttestEXP.display_name: FastH3 V2 · Verify LOW→Upscale→HIGH Origin (T8 EXP)
MiniMaxH3FastH3V2CurrentHandoffAttestEXP.description: Read-only proof of completed LOW x0, one learned 3D call, deterministic HIGH reconcile/prefix and actual HIGH sampler source. Does not accept a segment.

MiniMaxH3FastH3V2CurrentJobBindEXPT8.name: MiniMaxH3FastH3V2CurrentJobBindEXPT8
MiniMaxH3FastH3V2CurrentJobBindEXPT8.display_name: FastH3 V2 · Bind Current Job to Accepted Parent (T8 EXP)
MiniMaxH3FastH3V2CurrentJobBindEXPT8.description: Compare the completed two-stage job SHA with the immediate accepted parent's saved job SHA and context/model identities. Segment 0 requires no parent. Does not write, accept or compose a candidate.

MiniMaxH3FastH3V2CurrentMediaPrepareEXPT.name: MiniMaxH3FastH3V2CurrentMediaPrepareEXPT8
MiniMaxH3FastH3V2CurrentMediaPrepareEXPT.display_name: FastH3 V2 · Decode + Trim Bound HIGH (T8 EXP)
MiniMaxH3FastH3V2CurrentMediaPrepareEXPT.description: Call the unchanged native AV Decode and Output Trim once, using the authenticated completed HIGH output. Produce exact 124/68-frame media plus a typed source receipt. Does not save or accept a candidate.

MiniMaxH3FastH3V2CurrentCandidateSaveEXP.name: MiniMaxH3FastH3V2CurrentCandidateSaveEXPT8
MiniMaxH3FastH3V2CurrentCandidateSaveEXP.display_name: FastH3 V2 · Save Bound Candidate, Not Accepted (T8 EXP)
MiniMaxH3FastH3V2CurrentCandidateSaveEXP.description: Only consume the typed completed-HIGH media receipt and current job binding. Use the unchanged durable candidate writer, add a source sidecar and stop before human Review & Accept or composition.

MiniMaxH3FastH3V2ExternalColorMatchEXPT8.name: MiniMaxH3FastH3V2ExternalColorMatchEXPT8
MiniMaxH3FastH3V2ExternalColorMatchEXPT8.display_name: FastH3 V2 · External Accepted-Picture Color Match (T8 EXP)
MiniMaxH3FastH3V2ExternalColorMatchEXPT8.description: Apply the unchanged dual-loop RGB Color Match against the authenticated accepted parent after HIGH decode/trim. Audio and latent stay untouched; segment 0 is identity.

MiniMaxH3FastH3V2ColoredCandidateSaveEXP.name: MiniMaxH3FastH3V2ColoredCandidateSaveEXPT8
MiniMaxH3FastH3V2ColoredCandidateSaveEXP.display_name: FastH3 V2 · Save Externally Colored Candidate (T8 EXP)
MiniMaxH3FastH3V2ColoredCandidateSaveEXP.description: Save only a typed completed-HIGH + external Color Match result as an unaccepted candidate. Keeps the original raw-media candidate writer and sidecar intact.

MiniMaxH3FastH3V2CurrentCandidateReviewA.name: MiniMaxH3FastH3V2CurrentCandidateReviewAcceptEXPT8
MiniMaxH3FastH3V2CurrentCandidateReviewA.display_name: FastH3 V2 · Verify, Review & Explicitly Accept (T8 EXP)
MiniMaxH3FastH3V2CurrentCandidateReviewA.description: A separate review step for a saved split candidate. Verify its MP4/context, current-job/media sidecar and exact 124/68-frame boundary before calling the unchanged reject-existing manifest transaction. Defaults to preview only; never composes a movie.

MiniMaxH3FastH3V2CurrentAcceptedChainVer.name: MiniMaxH3FastH3V2CurrentAcceptedChainVerifyEXPT8
MiniMaxH3FastH3V2CurrentAcceptedChainVer.display_name: FastH3 V2 · Verify Accepted Two-Segment Source (T8 EXP)
MiniMaxH3FastH3V2CurrentAcceptedChainVer.description: Read-only verification of both accepted 124+68-frame segments, retained source-bound candidates, media/context hashes and one current job SHA before the unchanged long-video composer. Not a quality review.

MiniMaxH3FastH3V2FrozenLOWBundleSaveEXPT.name: MiniMaxH3FastH3V2FrozenLOWBundleSaveEXPT8
MiniMaxH3FastH3V2FrozenLOWBundleSaveEXPT.display_name: FastH3 V2 · Save Attested Frozen LOW Recipe (T8 EXP)
MiniMaxH3FastH3V2FrozenLOWBundleSaveEXPT.description: Attach the verified current recipe, executed LOW stage and actual LOW condition receipt to an exact completed Stage Save manifest. Does not change the generic stage artifact or freeze newly edited LOW settings.

MiniMaxH3FastH3V2FrozenLOWBundleLoadEXPT.name: MiniMaxH3FastH3V2FrozenLOWBundleLoadEXPT8
MiniMaxH3FastH3V2FrozenLOWBundleLoadEXPT.display_name: FastH3 V2 · Load Exact Frozen LOW Recipe (T8 EXP)
MiniMaxH3FastH3V2FrozenLOWBundleLoadEXPT.description: Revalidate an exact completed LOW artifact and its bound recipe, LOW stage attestation and condition call. No LOW MODEL or sampler runs; HIGH live inputs must still be attested independently.

MiniMaxH3FaceRelayBindEXPT8.name: MiniMaxH3FaceRelayBindEXPT8
MiniMaxH3FaceRelayBindEXPT8.display_name: H3 Face · Bind External Prompt Relay (T8 EXP)
MiniMaxH3FaceRelayBindEXPT8.description: Pair a full-clip standard Face refinement Stage with the stock external Relay MODEL/CONDITIONING. The Relay AV checks packed layout only; face-crop AV and untouched source audio stay authoritative. Not for Parity or windows.

MiniMaxH3FaceLocalRelayBindEXPT8.name: MiniMaxH3FaceLocalRelayBindEXPT8
MiniMaxH3FaceLocalRelayBindEXPT8.display_name: H3 Face Parity/Window · Bind Local Relay (T8 EXP)
MiniMaxH3FaceLocalRelayBindEXPT8.description: Pair a local Ref2VA Relay Plan and CONDITIONING with one signed Face repair window. Parent/window mapping remains source-bound. The Plan is local, not a silent slice of global film events. Sampled audio is not the delivered source soundtrack.

filename_prefix.tooltip: Relative filename prefix under output/MiniMaxH3/latent_checkpoints. A unique suffix is always added; absolute and traversal paths are rejected.

checkpoint_id.tooltip: Logical identity that must match when the checkpoint is reloaded.

confirm_save.tooltip: Safety gate. False only computes the exact content manifest and writes nothing; enable explicitly after reviewing the target and checkpoint ID.

verify_after_write.tooltip: Reloads the temporary safetensors file and verifies its embedded exact AV manifest before atomic placement. Keep enabled for resumable work.

hash_chunk_megabytes.tooltip: Maximum temporary CPU hash chunk. This changes memory/speed only, not the checkpoint content digest.

MiniMaxH3NativeLatentCheckpointPassThrou.name: MiniMaxH3NativeLatentCheckpointPassThroughSaveEXPT8
MiniMaxH3NativeLatentCheckpointPassThrou.display_name: MiniMax H3 Native AV Checkpoint Pass-through Save / 原生音画检查点串行保存 (EXP/T8)
MiniMaxH3NativeLatentCheckpointPassThrou.description: Non-output checkpoint writer for a single downstream delivery path. It preserves the exact AV latent while writing the same verified native checkpoint format. Repeated evaluation within one Core execution reuses the first file only after the exact AV manifest matches; confirm_save remains false by default.

mode.tooltip: report_only never expands frames. auto_conservative_exp applies only when all abstain gates pass. manual_ranges uses the ranges field exactly.

manual_ranges.tooltip: Examples: 36-60:4 or 1.5s-2.4s:3; used only in manual_ranges mode.

minimum_residual_motion.tooltip: Absolute decoded-frame residual gate after a small global-translation search. This prevents a quantile-only rule from always selecting something.

MiniMaxH3MotionOverloadAnalyzePassThroug.name: MiniMaxH3MotionOverloadAnalyzePassThroughEXPT8
MiniMaxH3MotionOverloadAnalyzePassThroug.display_name: MiniMax H3 Motion Overload Analyze Pass-through / 动作过载串行分析 (EXP/T8)
MiniMaxH3MotionOverloadAnalyzePassThroug.description: Runs the same source-bound motion analysis as the original node, but only as a downstream dependency. Use for single-output graph delivery when a non-idempotent checkpoint writer is upstream.

MiniMaxH3MotionStageAuditPassThroughEXPT.name: MiniMaxH3MotionStageAuditPassThroughEXPT8
